parameters.content:
# PART A: Message 1
### Someone accepted your connection request. Now it's time to send them the first message. Part A finds all those people and sends the opening message to each of them.

# PART B: Folllow Up Message 1
### You already sent the first message but got no reply. Enough time has passed. Part B sends the first follow-up 1 as reminder message to those people.

# PART C: Follow Up Message 2
### Still no reply after follow-up 1 message. More time has passed. Part C sends the second and final follow-up message.

# PART D: Mark Completed
### You sent all 3 messages (Message 1, Follow Up Message 1, Follow Up Message 2). 
### It has been 3 days since the last one. The person never replied. Part D closes their journey by marking them as "completed" && we won't send them anything more.

# PART E: Mark Campaign Completion
### Checks if an entire campaign is finished — meaning every single person in that campaign has been completed, replied, withdrawn, or failed. If yes, Part E marks the whole campaign as "completed" automatically.
